svg.title: Silverline Flooring Studio tile layout portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional flooring portfolio concept for Silverline Flooring Studio, showing a large-format porcelain tile floor with clean grout lines. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
